description: This source file implements logging functionalities for a testing or utility framework, including setting log file paths, writing logs with timestamps, and prefixing logs with additional context. It contains functions for log management, timestamp handling, and string processing, specifically targeting Linux environments.

methods.name: void UT_log_setLogFilePath(char * inputFilePath)
methods.description: Sets the log file path with a timestamp suffix based on the input directory.

methods.name: void UT_log(const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a message with timestamp, function name, and line number, printing to stdout and appending to the log file.

methods.name: void UT_logPrefix(const char * file,int line,const char * prefix,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a message with prefix, timestamp, function name, and line number, with optional color code stripping.

methods.name: char * UT_stripColorCode(char * in_string)
methods.description: Removes ANSI color codes from a string for clean logging output.
